name: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications
aliases: Nanjing Institute of Posts and Telecommunications
supervisors: Jiangsu Provincial Government (co-built with MIIT, the State Post Bureau and the Ministry of Education)

evidence.summary: A communication system that NUPT developed with a PLA research institute won a 2011 All-Army Science and Technology Progress Award, second class. From 2004 the Nanjing Military Region trained reserve officers ("national-defence students") at NUPT, and in 2025 a research institute of the PLA's National University of Defense Technology and NUPT's School of Communications and Information Engineering reported initial agreement to cooperate on research and graduate training.
NUPT says it has taken on several key-technology research tasks for military information systems.
Once directly under the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, NUPT has been co-built since 2000 by MIIT, the State Post Bureau, the Ministry of Education and Jiangsu Province.
